answer: Admission here runs on a triangle-free witness rule. A newcomer needs three established identities that have never settled with one another, and each of those witnesses stakes an anchor of copper exactly once, so legal triples thin out quadratically as the settled graph thickens. A farm is its own worst enemy: every pair its clones add creates an edge that spoils triples it may need later. Wealth offers no haven, because independence is measured against the whole settled graph and not the applicant's wishes, and a thousand aliases cannot conjure a thousand mutually unacquainted sponsors.
